name: Skavio USDC Payment Verification & Proof MCP
description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP with 18 discoverable tools for verifying native Circle USDC transfers on seven chains, exact recipient and amount matching, blockchain payment evidence PDF, and DNS/TLS auditing. Public discovery; priced calls require a wallet client capable of x402 v2 payment in native USDC on Base. Verification starts at 0.02 USDC; match 0.03, evidence PDF 0.05, DNS/TLS audit 0.05. Evidence PDFs are not tax invoices.
author: Skavio LLC
